title: Add Android grid control and menu scroll indicators
changes: Show a persistent right-hand indicator on scrollable Android menu panels and controller and touch dialogs.
Add persistent Grid auto and 0–100% strength controls using a filtered mobile LCD-grid approximation for world and game UI layers; Auto follows desktop profile defaults.
validation: ARM64 Docker build and 27 Kotlin tests passed in android-grid-scroll-apk-1ta3fdgb.
Mesa GLES compiled and linked both shaders and verified grid off/on and screen profile samples for world and panel layers in android-screen-grid-gles-f2wvtrg8.
Updated the connected moto g34 5G using adb install -r; original first-install time retained.
limitations: Android grid is a simplified filtered model, not pixel-equivalent to the desktop grid; physical-device visual appearance, scrolling and touch were not manually verified.
